title: eludite.git.sync input
description: Sync (Git > Sync; the status bar's sync arrows): Visual Studio's pull then push. Pulls as eludite.git.pull does (a fast-forward or a merge commit, stopping on a conflict, never a rebase), then pushes the branch to its upstream as eludite.git.push does. A pull that stops on a conflict pushes nothing. Credentials, progress and eludite.git.cancel as for fetch and push. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `git.push` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`.

remote.description: Default: the branch's upstream remote, else `origin`.
